Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: The exact Cascade34 seven-state realization is now on main (175db880) with independent dense-expm fixtures and 301 HRF tests/platform. It is impulse/point-observation only, not a finite-state likelihood backend, box forcing or performance admission.

Fresh context: Yes: deferred backend; realization delivered.

Next action: Keep PHRF-10 deferred until PHRF-33's complete decoded B0 measured decision explicitly activates it. Reuse the delivered realization if activated, and qualify every added innovation/drive/observation contract separately.

Evidence: docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md; live PHRF-33 dependency.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Checkpoint disposition 2026-09-13: remain OPEN at P3 and DEFERRED, now explicitly provisional pending PHRF-33. PHRF-07's backend timings did not execute the shared decoder or final readout certification, so they do not settle the full B0 decision.

Do not start finite-state implementation solely because this issue is open or appears ready. PHRF-33 must measure the unchanged complete workload and record a pass or a concrete activation decision. A passing complete checkpoint keeps this deferred. If TrialBanded misses the frozen engineering budget, PHRF-33 records the trigger, scope and release dependency changes that make PHRF-10 (and its required PHRF-30 realization) active. No universal finite-state gate is introduced without that evidence.

---
Prior implementation criteria retained for traceability (the dated scope clarification above governs where it differs):

Opened only by the PHRF-07 dense-overlap checkpoint. Scope as revision 1.
